# `carrier` records

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from schemas/0.1/carrier.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

A carrier on a mounting surface (doc 03 §16, rank 53, the layout file of its surface's space): a DIN rail or a
wiring duct. Its placements' poses are relative to it, so moving a rail moves its devices.

At the MVP carriers are axis-parallel (WP-S4.01 D5): a rail's `path` is two points on one horizontal or vertical
line, a duct's an orthogonal polyline; the commands refuse other angles.

| Item | Value |

| File | `layout/<space>.jsonl` |

## Types

### CarrierKind

The kind of a carrier (doc 03 §16). Format 0.1 types rails and ducts; busbar systems and the surface itself are
kept verbatim as `CarrierKind::Unknown`.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"rail"` | A mounting (DIN) rail. |
| `"duct"` | A wiring duct. |

### CarrierParams

The parameters of a carrier (doc 12 §2.4), tagged by the kind: `{"rail": {…}}` or `{"duct": {…}}`.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: A rail's parameters.

   Shape: object { `rail`: [`RailParams`](#railparams) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `rail` | [`RailParams`](#railparams) | yes |  | A rail's parameters (doc 12 §2.4). |

2. **Form 2**: A duct's parameters.

   Shape: object { `duct`: [`DuctParams`](#ductparams) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `duct` | [`DuctParams`](#ductparams) | yes |  | A duct's parameters (doc 12 §2.4): the nominal size, from which the label "W×H" ("40×60") is generated. |

### DuctParams

A duct's parameters (doc 12 §2.4): the nominal size, from which the label "W×H" ("40×60") is generated.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cover` | boolean or `null` | no |  | Whether the duct has its cover; absent: not recorded. |
| `height` | [`Nm`](#nm) | yes |  | The height out of the plate. |
| `slot_pitch` | [`Nm`](#nm) or `null` | no |  | The slot pitch; absent: from the part. |
| `width` | [`Nm`](#nm) | yes |  | The width across the duct. |

### Nm

A length in nanometres (doc 05 §3.2). Written without fraction or exponent; JSON Schema cannot tell 5 from 5.0, the reader rejects the latter.

Type: integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991)

### PartRef

A part on a device (doc 03 §7): the embedded copy and an optional part variant (FR-PRT-003).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `copy` | [`Uuid`](#uuid) | yes |  | The copy ID of the embedded part, `v5(NS_LIBCOPY, library ‖ item)`. |
| `variant` | [`Ident`](#ident) or `null` | no |  | A variant key of the part. |

### Ident

An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text.

Type: string (at least 1 character(s))

Pattern: `^[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000](?:[^\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]*[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000])?$`

### RailParams

A rail's parameters (doc 12 §2.4).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `profile` | [`MountKind`](#mountkind) | yes |  | The rail profile (TS 35×7.5); the mount kinds that fit it are a table in `ew-derive` (doc 12 §3.3). |

### MountKind

How a part mounts (doc 12 §2.5); also the profile of a rail section.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"ts35x7_5"` | Top-hat rail 35 × 7.5 mm. |
| `"ts35x15"` | Top-hat rail 35 × 15 mm. |
| `"ts32"` | G rail 32 mm. |
| `"ts15"` | Miniature top-hat rail 15 mm. |
| `"screw"` | Screwed to the mounting surface. |
| `"busbar_adapter"` | On a busbar adapter. |
| `"door_cutout"` | In a door cut-out. |
| `"on_parent"` | On its parent device. |
| `"none"` | Not mounted. |

### SurfacePt2

A point [u, v] in nanometres in the frame of a mounting surface, u to the right, v up (doc 03 §16): not a sheet point.

Type: array of (integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991), integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991)) (at least 2 item(s), at most 2 item(s))

### Uuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`
